topic: Why does your phone die at 30% in the cold? (the battery isn't empty)
research_summary: Candidates (score out of 40: curiosity, universality, timeliness, search, surprise, visual, shareability, verifiability): (1) Why phones die faster in the cold: 34 (4,5,4,4,4,4,4,5), the runner-up from this morning's scoring, winner of this second run of the day because the earlier Short was Delhi air (Earth & Nature). (2) Why UPI settles in seconds: 33. (3) Why prices end in 99 before Black Friday: 33 (no controlled study). (4) Why we can't tickle ourselves: 30. (5) Why we see our breath in winter: 28. Timely: winter has arrived across north India. How it works: a lithium-ion battery moves lithium ions through a liquid electrolyte; cold thickens the electrolyte and slows the ions, internal resistance rises, so under load the voltage sags and the phone's software reads the dip as nearly empty and shuts down, while the energy is still stored; the battery percentage is an estimate, not a measurement. The effect is temporary: Apple says battery life returns to normal when the device is brought back to higher temperatures, and that iPhones are designed for 0 to 35 degrees Celsius ambient (Apple Support, HT201678). Mechanism cross-checked across several explainer sources; their percentage figures (30% or 50% loss at -10 or -18 C) could not be verified against primary research, so no capacity-loss number is used. Analogy: oil thickening in winter. Safety kept simple: let a cold phone warm up before charging it, which matches Apple's guidance that a too-cold device may not charge.

english.title: Why Your Phone Dies at 30% in the Cold (It's Not Empty)
english.description: Why does your phone die at 30% in the cold? The battery isn't empty, it's cold: the liquid inside thickens, the ions slow down, and the voltage sags, so the phone thinks it's nearly empty. Here is how it works, why it's temporary, and what to do. #phonebattery #winter #howitworks #science

scenes.text: Your phone says thirty percent, then dies. The battery isn't empty, it's just cold.
Weird, right? A battery with charge left, and a phone that still shuts off. So what's going on?
Inside, lithium ions swim through a liquid called electrolyte. In the cold, that liquid gets thick, like oil in winter.
Slow ions struggle to deliver power. The voltage sags, and the phone reads that dip as nearly empty.
Quick quiz: your phone just died in the cold. What now? Take a guess.

graphic.headline: Phone died in the cold. Now?

scenes.text: Warm it up first! Apple designs iPhones for zero to thirty-five degrees Celsius, so zero is the line.
Battery damaged forever? That's the myth. The cold slowness is temporary, and it fades once the phone warms up.
So next time it dies outdoors, keep it in your pocket. Which gadget hates winter most? Tell me below, and follow for more.

hindi.title: ठंड में फ़ोन 30% पर क्यों बंद हो जाता है? (बैटरी खाली नहीं होती)
hindi.description: ठंड में फ़ोन 30% पर क्यों बंद हो जाता है? बैटरी खाली नहीं, ठंडी होती है: अंदर का तरल गाढ़ा हो जाता है, आयन धीमे पड़ते हैं, वोल्टेज गिरता है और फ़ोन को लगता है कि बैटरी लगभग खाली है। जानिए यह कैसे होता है, क्यों अस्थायी है, और क्या करें। #फ़ोनबैटरी #सर्दी #विज्ञान #hindi

scenes.text: आपका फ़ोन तीस प्रतिशत दिखाता है, फिर बंद हो जाता है। बैटरी खाली नहीं, बस ठंडी है।
अजीब है ना? चार्ज बचा है, फिर भी फ़ोन बंद। तो हुआ क्या?
अंदर लिथियम आयन तरल, यानी इलेक्ट्रोलाइट में तैरते हैं। ठंड में यह गाढ़ा हो जाता है, तेल जैसा।
धीमे आयन यानी बिजली देने में दिक्कत। वोल्टेज गिर जाता है, और फ़ोन उसे लगभग खाली समझ लेता है।
छोटा-सा क्विज़। ठंड में फ़ोन बंद हो गया, अब क्या करें? ज़रा अंदाज़ा लगाइए।
पहले गरम करें! एप्पल आईफ़ोन को शून्य से पैंतीस डिग्री के लिए बनाता है, तो शून्य याद रखिए।

scenes.text: क्या बैटरी हमेशा के लिए ख़राब हो गई? यही मिथक है। ठंड की सुस्ती अस्थायी है, गरम होते ही लौट आती है।
तो बाहर फ़ोन बंद हो, तो उसे जेब में रखिए। कौन-सा गैजेट सर्दी में नखरे करता है? कमेंट में बताइए, और फ़ॉलो करें।
